# Zoho People

Connect your own Zoho People account from Accounts. Choose Europe, United States or India to match your Zoho People address, then sign in. A hosted Zoho OAuth client makes this one click when configured; you can also enter a server-based OAuth client you own.

The core app covers employee records, forms and views, attendance, shifts, regularization, permission and WFH requests, leave and holidays, projects, jobs, clients, timesheets, time logs, timers, pay periods and work calendars. Each documented operation has its own tool. Every change asks for approval, including service endpoints that use GET to perform a write. Your account's roles, Zoho plan and API limits still apply.

The app requests the published permissions for these modules at connection time. Attendance, leave, employee counts and payroll settings include module-wide permissions where Zoho's reference requires them. Forms use metadata read and record read/create/update scopes; time tracking uses read/create/update/delete scopes. No CRM scopes are requested.

Tool parameters follow Zoho's names. Dates use your organization's configured format unless the operation accepts an explicit format. JSON values in query and form parameters are encoded for you. File inputs take a filename and base64 data; downloads return base64 data and the response content type. Time-log creation uses an existing job ID; project and job creation have their own tools.

Select the data center before sign-in. Your choice is used for sign-in, refresh and every API call. There is no automatic data-center routing. Regions outside EU, US and IN are not included yet.
